answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own atlas record, and its own share of the lagoon quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The crystal ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 1675 identities would post 749 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
